sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing in force for BR-225 requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. EN AW-7075 is a different alloy, so it does not meet the drawing material. It has no material id, and the documents give no yield value to show it meets SC-BR225-YS.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual, which replaces revision 3, requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment after a material change. It also requires notification 90 days ahead. No such approval is in the documents.
EN AW-7075 is not in the material master, so there is no yield or temper data. A person must supply the data, including the temper and the supplier.

sources.quote: Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No EN 10204 3.1 certificate for EN AW-7075 is on file from any supplier. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) should be asked whether one exists.
